投資一定有風險，基金投資有賺有賠，申購前應詳閱公開說明書。

news.Title: Microsoft (MSFT) Q1 2027 Earnings Call Transcript
news.Content:
Image source: The Motley Fool.

DATE

Wed, Oct. 28, 2026

CALL PARTICIPANTS

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer - Satya Nadella

Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer - Amy Hood

Chief Accounting Officer - Alice Jolla

Deputy General Counsel and Corporate Secretary - Brian DeFoe

Vice President, Investor Relations - Jonathan Neilson

Full Conference Call Transcript

Operator: Greetings, and welcome to the Microsoft Fiscal Year 2027 First Quarter Earnings Conference Call. [Operator Instructions] As a reminder, this conference is being recorded. It is now my pleasure to introduce Jonathan Neilson, Vice President, Investor Relations.

Jonathan Neilson: Good afternoon, and thank you for joining us today. On the call with me are Satya Nadella, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer; Amy Hood, Chief Financial Officer; Alice Jolla, Chief Accounting Officer; and Brian DeFoe, Deputy General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. On the Microsoft Investor Relations website, you can find our earnings press release and financial summary slide deck, which is intended to supplement our prepared remarks during today's call and provides the reconciliation of differences between GAAP and non-GAAP financial measures. More detailed outlook slides will be available on the Microsoft Investor Relations website when we provide outlook commentary on today's call. On this call, we will discuss certain non-GAAP items.

The non-GAAP financial measures provided should not be considered as a substitute for or superior to the measures of financial performance prepared in accordance with GAAP. They are included as additional clarifying items to aid investors in further understanding the company's first quarter performance in addition to the impact these items and events have on the financial results. All growth comparisons we make on the call today relate to the corresponding period of last year, unless otherwise noted. We will also provide growth rates in constant currency when available as a framework for assessing how our underlying business performed, excluding the effect of foreign currency rate fluctuations.

Where growth rates are the same in constant currency, we will refer to the growth rate only. We will post our prepared remarks to our website immediately following the call until the complete transcript is available. Today's call is being webcast live and recorded. If you ask a question, it will be included in our live transmission, in the transcript and in any future use of the recording. You can replay the call and view the transcript on the Microsoft Investor Relations website. During this call, we will be making forward-looking statements, which are predictions, projections or other statements about future events. These statements are based on current expectations and assumptions that are subject to risks and uncertainties.

Story Continues

Actual results could materially differ because of factors discussed in today's earnings press release, in the comments made during this conference call and in the Risk Factors section of our Form 10-K, Forms 10-Q and other reports and filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission. We do not undertake any duty to update any forward-looking statements. And with that, I'll turn the call over to Satya.

Satya Nadella: Thank you very much, Jonathan. It was a fast start to our fiscal year. Microsoft Cloud revenue surpassed $63 billion with growth accelerating to 30% year-over-year. We are focused on 3 things: designing AI to empower people, ensuring every organization has sovereignty over its own learning and building trust with controls that ensure agent safety and security. Now let's talk about how we are making progress on those goals as we build a new tech stack, starting with Copilot. We announced our biggest update to Copilot to date this quarter, bringing together Chat, Cowork, Autopilot and Code into one unified experience. It's one product experience across commercial and consumer and comes with all of Office built in.

We think of Copilot as the new OS for work. Customers are increasingly turning to Copilot to get real work done. Automated tasks have nearly doubled since July. Daily users are up nearly 50% quarter-over-quarter and over 5x year-over-year. User satisfaction improved nearly 20% quarter-over-quarter to another all-time high. And 90% of Copilot queries use Auto mode, which dynamically routes tasks across models optimizing for quality, speed and cost. These improvements are translating into larger purchases. The number of customers with more than 50,000 Copilot seats increased over 8x year-over-year, including Capgemini, HCLTech, Hitachi Group, Truist Financial and U.K. Revenue and Customs Department.

And just last week, Volkswagen announced plans to deploy Copilot to more than 330,000 employees, one of the largest deployments to date in Europe. We're also seeing strong momentum with E7, which brings together Copilot, E5, Entra and Agent 365. Thousands of customers in every industry have purchased the suite to date, including Amadeus, BlackRock, Fiserv and New South Wales Health Department and ZEISS. Our business model is expanding from per seat subscriptions to include consumption, expanding our TAM and ARPU. The subscription brings increasingly capable everyday intelligence to every user. Typically, IT funds this, consolidating frontier advances for everyone across the organization.

And as agents take on higher-value work, consumption opens up business funded demand with spending tied directly to the value these agents deliver. The number of Copilot customers actively consuming credits through usage-based billing grew over 75% over the quarter. When it comes to software development, all major coding agents have shown up to work on GitHub. Agent-generated PRs have increased 6x over the past 6 months, and agents now open more than 1/3 of all PRs on the platform. We are very hard at work on reliability as agentic activity on GitHub soars. At GitHub Universe this morning, we shared how we are expanding capacity and rebuilding the core Git architecture for the Agentic wave.

Also at Universe, we announced broad availability of Copilot Fusion, which is all about bringing multi-model orchestration to software development. It delivers frontier-level quality up to 40% faster and at up to 77% lower cost. Credit consumption from Agentic features on GitHub has more than doubled since usage-based billing went into effect. And we're also helping developers secure their code and turn AI-generated code into high-quality software. GitHub Advanced Security revenue increased over 50% year-over-year as customers use its AI capabilities to scan entire repos and fix vulnerabilities in real time.

In the business application space, we are extending this vision of Copilot as the new OS for work, bringing the business logic and capabilities of Dynamics 365 directly into Copilot and helping every organization stand up their own infinite SaaS factory. This quarter, we introduced 30 new Copilot skills across Dynamics 365, which enables customers to access CRM and ERP capabilities directly in the flow of work. In recruiting, more than 10 million LinkedIn members use our LinkedIn AI-powered job search daily and 25,000 customers are using our agentic hiring solutions. Recruiters using Hiring Assistant are finding interview quality applicants 33% faster while reviewing 83% fewer profiles to find qualified match.

The second piece is this real focus on efficiency because efficiency, when we say the word, I think people believe it's cost related. The outcome is cost related. But the real benefit of efficiency is stability, it's security, it's reliability, is that it delivers the highest quality unit at the lowest possible cost. And so it's operational excellence.

And so I think when you think about you can deliver product excellence, which is what we're really focused on, and I think we did a very good job on product quality in the past quarter, which I think team should be proud of in lots of places. I think then you have this sort of operational focus on improvement. And then it is a real focus in terms of operating expense to make sure it's going towards building the new thing or providing security and quality. And I think that's -- we've made, I think, a very active choice to be really focused on those 2 things, especially in this environment and how important it is.

And I think when you do those things and you happen to be in a good market with breadth and breadth of customers and a global business, we've seen a good result. This quarter, in particular, when you're delivering a lot of efficiency gains in a quarter and you can deliver revenue growth without spending additional costs, you, of course, see a benefit, which we did. But I feel good about what's behind that number, which is, I think, a focus on the right levers.

Operator: Our next question comes from the line of Brad Reback with Stifel.

Brad Reback: Great. Sorry about that. I did not hear my name. On M365 consumption, when you all shifted GitHub from a per seat model to a consumption model, it unlocked a ton of revenue growth for you all. As you think about the tools in place now unlocked on the consumption side for the core M365 customer, do you think the unlocks is fast and without sales effort? Or is it going to take a fair amount of effort to get those meters spinning?

Satya Nadella: Yes. Thanks for the question. I think on the coding side, it will be faster just because I think people are used to paying on this PayGo as the sort of the general market and how it works. And if anything, hopefully, some of the things that we announced even at GitHub Universe today with Fusion are a more attractive way, right? Because you even -- if you think about it, right, you buy a bunch of credits and you want to use those credits most efficiently. That's the promise of GitHub Copilot Fusion. So we are very optimistic about making progress on that.

And then when it comes to Copilot itself, right, we are trying to make sure that we, in some sense, are driving more and more value into the subscription with every model drop and essentially consolidating the frontier gains for broad deployment. And in many instances, as my remarks said, IT funds this, right? That's the thing that you want to have standard issue across the board. And at the same time, you have your Pay-As-You-Go or consumption meters for places where you need it. And so -- so both of those options are open. And I think that's why the -- in the Copilot, Amy referenced, which is we are trying to make sure that customers understand both options.

They're able to use the 2 options in the optimal way that benefits them. We don't want them to overbuy one thing and then feel like they're token maxing because that doesn't serve anybody's purpose. We want to make sure that they understand the value of the subscription and how it's a continually improving value. It's not even static. And at the same time, you can exercise this consumption meter. And so that's a little bit of the degree of sophistication in both in our sales motions, even customers' understanding that's, I think, coming together. We feel very good about the progress, but a lot more to do.

Amy Hood: And I think I would say it's also why we've made the investment into the frontier company here, coupled with changes in our sales motion, which I talked a little bit about. We need both of those things to make sure customers are -- because what I think Satya is saying, we want them to utilize both the Copilot license to its fullest and understand when the consumption meter is delivering value to them. The investment in the FDE organization or the Frontier Core Co, as well as new motions within our modern work and Microsoft 365 sales teams are both meant to do that. And I think to Satya's point, it will be a slower move outside of coding.

But I also still think we're still seeing encouraging signs, and I feel positive about that.

Jonathan Neilson: Operator, we have time for one last question.

Operator: The next question will come from the line of Tal Liani with Bank of America.

Tal Liani: Just a clarification on something you just said. Did you disclose the Copilot numbers this quarter? But my question is more about the capital commitment or the capital strategy. You said in the prepared remarks that you will approach raising capital if need be in the future. Can you discuss your strategy around it between debt and equity and other sources? How do you intend to raise capital if need be?

Amy Hood: Great. I'll take that. Look, I think what I said is that if it's attractive and makes sense, we're lucky. We have a lot of flexibility in terms of our capacity to raise financing. I've talked about this before. There's a form of financing called leasing, and we've been using that one as a vehicle. There's also -- we're fortunate to have access in the debt markets given that where our ratings are and sort of we haven't been able to -- we haven't yet, I would say, tapped that. And then, of course, there's other options. But I think the way I see it is we're feeling good that we're free cash flow positive.

We feel good that the return on every dollar of CapEx we're spending, we're confident in that. And therefore, we feel like we have lots of options to be able to tap the financing markets when they make sense and they're attractive. And we did not disclose to answer your direct question, an update on the Copilot number this quarter. We talked about momentum in revenue and usage.

Jonathan Neilson: Thanks, Tal. That wraps up the Q&A portion of today's earnings call. Thank you for joining us today, and we look forward to speaking with all of you soon.

Satya Nadella: Thank you all.

Operator: Thank you. This concludes today's conference. You may disconnect your lines at this time, and we thank you for your participation.

news.Title: 外資加碼日股、買超額"破兆"；日人續買海外股票

外資再度加碼日股，週買超額衝破1兆日圓大關。而日本投資人(日人)連2週加碼海外股票。

日本財務省29日公佈統計數據指出，上週(10月18-24日)外資在日本股市買超1兆1,809億日圓，為4週來第3度加碼日股，週買超額再度衝破1兆日圓大關；2026年迄今(截至10月24日為止)外資買超日股的累計金額擴大至9兆7,709億日圓。

Release Date: October 28, 2026

For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript .

Positive Points

Alphabet Inc ( NASDAQ:GOOG ) revenues grew 25% year over year to $127.6 billion, marking the 13th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

Google Cloud revenues surged 103% to $30.7 billion, driven by AI infrastructure and solutions, with operating income more than tripling.

Search query growth is the highest in five years, fueled by AI investments and new AI-powered features like AI Overviews and AI Mode.

The Gemini app reached 1 billion users, becoming the fastest-growing product in Google's history, and YouTube surpassed 150 million Music and Premium subscribers.

Alphabet Inc ( NASDAQ:GOOG ) is at the forefront of AI innovation with the launch of Gemini 4 series (Argon and Carbon) and Genie 4, driving strong demand and developer adoption.

Negative Points

Free cash flow turned negative at -$9.1 billion in Q3 due to heavy capital expenditures and inventory buildup for TPU system sales.

Operating expenses rose 20%, with R&D up 36% and sales and marketing up 22%, pressuring margins despite revenue growth.

Search revenue growth decelerated to 12% from prior quarters, impacted by FX headwinds, vertical-specific dynamics, and low monetization in AI Mode.

Google Cloud margins are expected to face near-term headwinds from utilizing third-party compute capacity and ramping TPU system sales.

Other income and expenses were negative $8.2 billion, primarily due to unrealized losses from investments like SpaceX, reducing net income.

Q & A Highlights

Q : Doug Anmuth (JPMorgan) asked Sundar to elaborate on his comment that 2027 could be a "golden age of productivity" for Google, and asked Philipp to explain the disconnect between the fastest query growth in five years and decelerating Search revenue growth. A : CEO Sundar Pichai said the step change began with internal models like 3.8 Flash but accelerated sharply once Argon was deployed internally, calling it one of the most meaningful productivity levers Google has seen in software engineeringtracking high-quality code checked in, faster check-in rates, and fewer rollbacks. He noted Argon deployment is only about four weeks old and Carbon, a meaningful step up, is now rolling out internally, reinforcing his "golden year" comment. Chief Business Officer Philipp Schindler attributed the Q3 Search growth deceleration (12% YoY to $63 billion) to three factors: FX was the single largest driver; vertical dynamics including APAC retail advertisers hit by the EU eliminating its de minimis exemption and media/entertainment normalizing after an unseasonably strong Q2 tied to the FIFA World Cup; and strong growth in low-monetization AI Mode queries. He added that Google is now scaling ads in AI Overviews and AI Mode to more users and queries, including international markets and multi-turn ads in the US.

Q : Brian Nowak (Morgan Stanley) asked what technological hurdles remain to shipping agentic products to the full user basemodel efficiency, capacity, or readinessand asked Anat to clarify the Search performance comparison dynamics heading into Q4 and Q1. A : Pichai said the Gemini 4 series has been important, and Google is working on distilled versions of Carbon to deploy at billion-user scale efficiently across compute, latency, and quality. He stressed that a capable model alone isn't enough at scalea robust harness, secure runtime (where GCP comes in), and the right ecosystem of skills and connectors are required. Google deliberately launched with Gemini Agent for Enterprise first due to the highest security and governance bar, and will bring the experience to consumers starting with the 1 billion Gemini app users later this year. CFO Anat Ashkenazi said FX will be a somewhat larger headwind to Q4 results at current spot rates, and Google is lapping the Search growth acceleration seen at the end of 2025about 3 points of growth impact versus Q3with a couple of points of lapping expected to continue in Q4.

Q : Eric Sheridan (Goldman Sachs) asked about Google's key priorities for allocating compute as it becomes available, and how the view on applying compute to cloud customer needs versus external TPU sales continues to evolve. A : Pichai said compute allocation is a long-range planning process, not a short-term exercise, with each business area submitting long-range plans under a disciplined ROIC framework. He noted Google operates a scale consumer business, a hyperscale cloud with momentum, and other important bets, all underpinned by AI modelsand the full-stack approach drives efficiency and optionality amid robust demand signals. Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said Cloud manages a broad customer portfolio spanning digital natives, AI labs, enterprises, and financial/capital markets customers, with over 100 significant TPU customers starting in Google Cloud. He outlined a deliberate three-part TPU approach: building the right silicon (8T for training, 8I for inference with substantial price-performance gains), optimizing software including PyTorch portability, and broadening distributionnow offering TPU systems in customer data centers and through partners like Oracle and the Crux AI joint venture with Blackstone.

Q : Ross Sandler (Barclays) asked what percentage of a TPU full-system sale (roughly $35 billion per gigawatt) is recognized as revenue and the margin flow-through versus the Cloud segment, and what handing off first-party infrastructure to AI labs like Anthropic means for Alphabet's CapEx intensity. A : Ashkenazi declined to provide product-level financials but explained that a TPU system is far more than a chipcombining hardware, compute, storage, networking, and software for training and inferencedelivering significant added value. When an agreement is signed, it first shows up in backlog, then Google builds inventory ahead of revenue, so cash goes out before cash comes ina different cycle than traditional CapEx. She noted some system sales have been recorded as revenue, with more expected through 2027. Kurian added that inventory is only procured against signed contracts, and placing TPU systems in third-party and customer data centers broadens the addressable market (including industries that cannot move data to the cloud) while offsetting the need for Google to pre-build hosting facilities.

Q : Justin Post (Bank of America) asked how Google plans to manage the Search transition to agentic usewhether it could be a headwindand whether agentic could drive more monetization long-term, plus why TPU sales are a good business even without disclosed margins. A : Schindler said agentic experiences are clearly additive, with Google building trusted, secure, hyperscale experiences and foundational commerce layers like the Universal Commerce Protocol, Universal Cart, and agent payments protocols. He argued users want choice beyond pricebrand loyalty, customer serviceso Google is designing agentic workflows that intentionally preserve space for exploration, enabling compelling ad models, subscriptions, and other payment methods in an agentic world. Pichai framed agents as an expansion opportunity, similar to how AI chat use cases let people ask and do more in Search, and noted people underestimate the deep investments like the Knowledge Graph required to deliver these experiences. Kurian said TPU systems offer price-performance advantages amid scarce accelerated compute, Google is focused on improving margins as the business scales, and scale economies in semiconductors directly translate into better economics.

Q : Mark Shmulik (Alliance Bernstein) asked what has surprised Google or changed its view from early agentic use cases on Gemini and AI Mode, including third-party integrations, and whether Thomas could share Cloud growth excluding TPU system sales and how much capacity constraints have limited it. A : Pichai said Google recently added an agent tab in the Gemini app to observe agent queries, and that users demand delightrepeat use depends on handling longer tasks and delivering satisfactory outcomes. He compared it to coding: at 70% success it looks like it doesn't work, but it takes off past a certain threshold, and he expects significant progress across surfaces through later this year and 2027. Kurian said Cloud delivered record growth with revenue up 103% to $30.7 billion, with GCP the vast majority and strongest contributor across both AI and core GCP, and growth excluding TPU systems was again very strong. He described three growth vectors: Gemini usage itself, Gemini driving adjacent consumption (compute for agents, storage for agent memory

news.Content:

Release Date: October 28, 2026

For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript .

Positive Points

KLA Corp ( NASDAQ:KLAC ) reported record revenue of $4.14 billion, up 29% year-over-year, and guided December quarter revenue to approximately $4.7 billion, demonstrating accelerating growth.

Operating margin exceeded 46% for the first time in company history, reflecting strong operating leverage and disciplined execution.

Advanced packaging process control revenue is on track to reach approximately $1.1 billion in calendar 2026, growing over 70% year-over-year, nearly twice the market growth rate.

Services revenue grew 14% year-over-year to $850 million, driven by a growing installed base and increasing demand for tool performance and productivity.

KLA Corp ( NASDAQ:KLAC ) expects to outgrow the wafer equipment market in calendar 2027, with a strong backlog and sales funnel visibility, and anticipates the wafer equipment market to exceed $200 billion in 2027.

Story Continues

Negative Points

Gross margin was 62.7%, slightly above the midpoint, but persistently high memory costs for system image processing continue to pressure margins.

Supply chain constraints, particularly for long lead time optical components, have limited KLA Corp ( NASDAQ:KLAC )'s ability to fully meet demand, with lead times averaging around 12 months and extending for some products.

China revenue as a percentage of total is expected to decline to the low 20th percentile in 2027, growing at a slower rate than the overall business.

Operating expenses are forecasted to grow sequentially through 2027, which could impact operating margin leverage if revenue growth slows.

The company faces potential delays in customer fab readiness, which could affect equipment delivery schedules and revenue recognition.

Q & A Highlights

Q : With WFE expected to exceed $200 billion in calendar 2027, how confident are you that KLA can outgrow the roughly 30% market growth, and how does 2027 shape up? A : CEO Rick Wallace said the 2027 setup is "very leading-edge-centric," with breadth of leading-edge node investment, greenfield DRAM, HVM dynamics lifting process control intensity, and advanced packaging growing faster than the market. He noted supply is much improved after 12 months of work, though he is "still behind in supply," with the trajectory nonetheless supporting guidance.

Q : Will 2027 be more linear or back-half loaded, given the strong second-half 2026 ramp? A : CEO Rick Wallace said backlog growth and funnel visibility imply sequential growth for the next several quarters, which suggests a stronger second half, but he expects 2027 to be "more linear" than 2026, without the same significant half-to-half uptick.

Q : Given memory and other cost headwinds, can gross margin return to the 63%+ range in 2027? A : CEO Rick Wallace said the 63%64% target range remains the goal, but advanced packaging and non-semi PC growth are a mix headwind, offset by scale and value-based pricing on new capabilities. He expects improvement as the company moves through 2027, particularly in the middle-to-back half and into 2028, consistent with the March Investor Day model.

Q : When could process control gross margin, which was above 65% in June 2025, return to the mid-60s as DRAM contracts roll off? A : CFO Bren Higgins said on a consistent mix he can see it trending back there in the second half of 2027, since it is difficult to raise prices on existing backlog but new product deals should help. CEO Rick Wallace added that engineering work to use less memory in systems will lower memory content over time, though it takes time to implement.

Q : What are you seeing on lead times, and how are you preparing hiring and the supply chain for a multi-year growth cycle? A : CFO Bren Higgins said lead times average around 12 months, with some products such as Gen4 and Gen5 extending further. KLA is adding headcount in manufacturing, service, applications and engineering, and investing in every factory and with key suppliers, particularly in long lead-time optics, to support a multi-year investment cycle.

Q : Will KLA gain WFE share in 2027 given 12-plus month lead times and low-to-mid-30s market growth? A : CFO Bren Higgins said 2026's first-half weakness was a supply issue rather than demand, and the company remains short on supply today. He feels good about maintaining and growing KLA's relevant share, noting the inflecting parts of the market uniquely benefit process control. CEO Rick Wallace added, "We think we can outgrow next year."

Q : DRAM systems revenue is stepping up sharply in December is this driven by new fabs or rising inspection intensity? A : CEO Rick Wallace said intensity is definitely rising as customers appreciate the incremental value of yield on advanced devices with higher performance requirements. CFO Bren Higgins added that greenfield fabs are driving retooling, yield is "equivalent to printing money," and HBM, I/O counts and logic base die requirements are pushing DRAM intensity in some products toward leading-edge logic levels. Memory is expected to be about 60% of the business in 2027.

Q : How high can WFE grow, and is $300 billion a plausible peak? A : CFO Bren Higgins said the Investor Day view of $220 billion plus or minus $20 billion for 2030 now "looks like a very conservative one," and KLA is more optimistic about higher industry investment levels. The company is having deep conversations with key suppliers about 2029 and 2030 needs to support higher-end scenarios.

Q : Why shouldn't the 2030 model revenue be achievable in 2027 given current WFE levels? A : CFO Bren Higgins said the model assumed service growth tied to installed base expansion, non-semi PC growth, and a few points of semi process control share gain lifting overall share from about 7.5% of wafer equipment in 2025 toward 9%. Those assumptions are not yet met, but he sees no reason the financial model would not perform as laid out as growth comes from the same customers for the same products.

Q : Is the 40%50% incremental operating margin range structurally higher given current performance? A : CFO Bren Higgins said it depends on growth rates: in a normalized environment KLA performs near the midpoint, but with roughly 25% revenue growth it is slightly above the top end, and he expects to be beyond that in 2030. At company growth rates closer to 20%, he would expect performance at the top end of the model or better.

Q : What drove the record CapEx this quarter, and how should we think about CapEx and services growth going forward? A : CFO Bren Higgins said a significant land purchase in India for a new campus drove the quarter. He expects CapEx of roughly 2%3% of revenue, trending to $600$800 million per year as KLA invests at every site. On services, he sees no reason it would not operate at the high end of the long-term growth range in 2027 given installed base growth and high utilization.

Q : Where is KLA in expanding supply, and could December guidance or the $200 billion WFE view have been higher with more supply? A : CFO Bren Higgins said optical components remain the longest lead-time constraint, but KLA does not compete with rivals for its key components, making supply relatively reliable once scheduled. He acknowledged he could have shipped more this year as demand outpaced supply, but incremental supply is coming online month by month. CEO Rick Wallace added that some customers are delaying tool deliveries because their fabs are not ready.

Q : What are the supply and clean-room impediments to the expected 2028 acceleration? A : CEO Rick Wallace said bottlenecks move around construction delays, power availability and raw materials can all hold up fabs, similar to data

Pichai said Alphabet's artificial-intelligence investments contributed to its fastest year-over-year query growth rate in five years. Search revenue rose 12% to $63.3 billion, with retail the largest contributor to growth, followed by finance.

The company is expanding AI features across Search, including AI Overviews and AI Mode. Pichai said AI Mode queries are, on average, three times longer than traditional searches, while one in five global AI Mode searches use voice, images or documents. Alphabet also surpassed 50 billion visual searches per month.

Story Continues

→ A 70% Rally Isn't Chord Energy's Only Selling Point

Anthropic's IPO Filing Reveals a Massive Opportunity for AI Infrastructure Giants

Philipp Schindler, Alphabet's senior vice president and chief business officer, said the company is scaling ads in AI Overviews and AI Mode to additional users and queries. Alphabet is also expanding AI Mode advertising internationally and introducing multi-turn ads in AI Mode in the U.S.

Schindler said most AI Mode queries are incremental and may create additional monetization opportunities over time, though lower monetization in AI Mode affected Search growth during the quarter. He attributed the deceleration in Search growth relative to the prior quarter primarily to foreign-exchange effects, as well as retail and media-specific factors.

→ Not All Tech Is Getting Crushed: 5 Names Holding Up Through the AI Sell-Off

Alphabet's Gemini app reached 1 billion users, which Pichai described as the fastest-growing product in Google's history. First-party model APIs processed nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, up 40% sequentially and more than four times the level of a year ago.

The company announced Gemini 4 Carbon, which Pichai called its strongest frontier model, following the recent release of Gemini 4 Argon. Carbon is initially being rolled out to a subset of trusted cyber defenders and is being tested by the U.S. government. Pichai said Alphabet expects to introduce more efficient model versions intended to improve speed, cost and deployment across its consumer products.

Google Cloud revenue more than doubles

Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7 billion, driven by growth in Google Cloud Platform, AI infrastructure, AI solutions and core cloud services. TPU system sales were also a meaningful contributor, according to CFO Anat Ashkenazi. Cloud operating income more than tripled to $11.1 billion, and the segment's operating margin increased to 36.2% from 23.7% a year earlier.

Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said the business now has 18 product lines producing more than $1 billion each in annual revenue. Its backlog reached $561 billion, with Alphabet expecting to recognize just over 55% of that amount as revenue over the next 24 months.

Kurian said more than 2,600 customers have used at least 100 billion tokens over the past 12 months, while nearly 90% of Fortune 100 companies use Gemini Enterprise. Alphabet has sold more than 100 million knowledge-work seats across its AI services, he said.

Demand for TPU systems remains strong, with nearly 100 customers currently using the systems. Kurian highlighted agreements involving Anthropic, Apple, Oracle and Crux AI, among others. Ashkenazi said system sales require Alphabet to build inventory after contracts are signed and before revenue is recognized, creating a different cash-flow cycle than traditional capital expenditures. She said more TPU system revenue is expected in 2027.

YouTube subscriptions, Waymo expansion and investment outlook

YouTube advertising revenue increased 9% to $11.2 billion, with brand advertising the largest contributor and notable strength in living-room viewing. Schindler said living-room viewing accounted for more than one-third of total YouTube ad revenue during the quarter.

Alphabet surpassed 150 million YouTube Music and Premium subscribers globally, including trials. Subscription platforms and devices revenue increased 11% to $14.3 billion, driven by YouTube subscriptions and demand for AI plans in Google One.

Pichai said Waymo had driven more than 300 million fully autonomous miles and now operates in 15 major U.S. cities. The company recently opened public service in San Antonio, San Diego and Tampa, while planning expansions into Canada, Germany, Singapore and Spain. Other Bets revenue was $372 million, while its operating loss was $2 billion as Alphabet continued to invest in Waymo and other initiatives.

Capital expenditures totaled $51.4 billion in the third quarter, primarily for technical infrastructure supporting AI investments. Alphabet maintained its 2026 CapEx guidance of $195 billion to $205 billion and said it expects capital expenditures to increase significantly in 2027. Ashkenazi said the increased infrastructure investment will raise depreciation and data-center operating costs, while third-party computing capacity coming online in the fourth quarter is expected to create near-term Cloud margin headwinds.

Alphabet ended the quarter with $265.1 billion in cash and marketable securities and $125.1 billion in long-term debt. The board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per share, payable in December.

About Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG)

Alphabet Inc is a technology holding company best known as the parent organization of Google. Founded in 2015 through a corporate restructuring, Alphabet oversees Google and a collection of businesses focused on technology, online services, communications, artificial intelligence, and other emerging areas.

Google's principal products and services include its internet search engine, digital advertising platforms, YouTube, Android, Chrome, Google Maps, Google Play, and Google Workspace. The company also provides cloud computing, data storage, cybersecurity, productivity, and artificial intelligence services through Google Cloud.

news.Title: 法說前送暖！ 大摩喊讚聯發科：目標上看6188元
news.Content:
根據摩根士丹利最新研究報告指出，聯發科在AI ASIC服務領域展現強大的執行力與設計能力，受惠於Google TPU v8t量產，預估第四季營收將顯著成長，並維持對其「優於大盤」評等，目標價上看6,188元。

聚焦AI ASIC發展與第四季展望

摩根士丹利表示，聯發科將於10月30日舉行第三季法說會。聯發科第三季營收較前一季成長10%，表現優於預期。展望第四季，儘管智慧型手機與消費性電子需求較為疲弱，導致非AI業務營收可能季減10%至20%，但在規模達20億美元的TPU v8t大規模量產帶動下，預估第四季整體營收將較前一季成長30%至40%。在毛利率方面，由於AI ASIC業務可能稀釋企業整體毛利率，預估第四季毛利率將下滑至44%至45%。

針對市場關注的2027年與2028年展望，預期聯發科將對2027年AI ASIC的潛在市場規模或市占率抱持更積極的看法，主要受惠於CoWoS與基板供應能見度提升。供應鏈調查顯示，台積電約有1萬8千片CoWoS產能可能分配給Google TPU v8t，支援高達360萬顆產量的生產，其中預估有300萬顆將認列為聯發科2027年的營收。

Google TPU專案進展

在Google TPU v9專案方面，大摩表示，這是聯發科2028年的主要營收成長動能，市場先前曾對英特爾EMIB-T基板供應抱持疑慮。摩根士丹利預期，聯發科將在法说會上說明TPU v9專案大致按計畫進行，預計於2027年初下線，並如先前預期於2028年初開始大規模量產。此外，聯發科未來也有機會爭取第二家甚或第三家雲端服務供應商客戶。儘管面臨手機與消費性電子需求疲弱，大摩看好聯發科第四季整體營收仍可望季增30～40%，重申「優於大盤」評等，目標價維持6,188元。

news.Title: Asia stocks fall as Alphabet, Samsung results disappoint; more tech earnings loom
news.Content:
Investing.com-- Asian stocks fell on Thursday, surrendering early gains as disappointing results from Alphabet and a sell-off in Samsung Electronics weighed on technology shares, while investors awaited earnings from Amazon and Intel for further clues on the outlook for artificial intelligence investment.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

U.S. stock index futures also fell in Asian trading Thursday, with Nasdaq 100 Futures sliding 1.5%. Wall Street ended slightly higher overnight.

Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) shares slumped about 10% in after-hours U.S. trading after the company reported results that fell short of expectations and signalled heavy spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure. Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), by contrast, gained about 3% after its results showed stronger-than-expected cash flow.

S.Korea's KOSPI retreats on Samsung chip profit miss

South Korea's KOSPI fell about 3%. Samsung Electronics (KS:005930) shares dropped nearly 6% despite the company reporting record third-quarter earnings, as investors focused on a miss in semiconductor profit expectations and uncertainty over additional shareholder returns.

Investors were also disappointed that Samsung did not provide immediate details of additional shareholder returns, with the company saying it would finalise its next policy in January. Its mobile business recorded an operating loss of 800 billion won as higher memory costs squeezed profitability.

Samsung warned that AI-driven memory demand would outstrip industry supply in 2027 and projected semiconductor capital expenditure of 76.8 trillion won this year, up 62% from 2025.

The decline followed a rally of nearly 7% in the KOSPI on Wednesday, when SK Hynix (KS:000660) surged 11% after reporting a stronger-than-expected profit and announcing a 100 trillion won ($75 billion) shareholder-return plan. SK Hynix shares rose a further 1.6% on Thursday.

Elsewhere, China's Shanghai Composite fell 1.2% and the blue-chip Shanghai Shenzhen CSI 300 index slipped 1.2%, with chip stocks leading losses.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Hong Kong's Hang Seng traded largely flat, although its Hang Seng TECH sub-index slid 2%.

Japan's Nikkei 225 edged 0.2% higher after erasing most of its gains, while the broader TOPIX index fell 0.3%.

Story Continues

Australia's S&P/ASX 200 gained 0.4%, while Singapore's Straits Times Index edged up 0.1%.

Futures tied to India's Nifty 50 fell 0.3%.

Fed holds steady; BOJ decision awaited

Investors were also preparing for the Bank of Japan's policy decision on Friday, after its two-day meeting began on Thursday.

The central bank is widely expected to keep its policy rate at 1.25%, following a rate increase in September, while potentially raising its inflation forecasts as higher oil prices and a weak yen add to price pressures.

Markets will scrutinise Governor Kazuo Ueda's comments for clues on whether the BOJ could raise rates again as soon as December.

The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady on Wednesday, although two policymakers voted in favour of a rate increase.

Markets were pricing in roughly a 78% chance of a U.S. rate increase in December, according to CME FedWatch, leaving investors sensitive to incoming inflation data. September's U.S. personal consumption expenditures price index, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, is due on Friday.

Attention later shifts to Amazon and Intel, whose results and guidance will help investors assess whether strong AI demand can sustain the enormous spending on data centres, chips and cloud infrastructure.

news.Title: 爸媽送10張台積電 兒離婚媳能拿？ 律師揭關鍵：「這筆錢」恐分一半
news.Content:
父母辛苦累積財富，想送兒子10張台積電（2330）股票，卻擔心孩子未來婚姻生變，資產會不會被媳婦分走？恩典法律事務所主持律師蘇家宏近日透過影片解析，他提醒，股票持有期間累積的股利、股息，若未花用而持續留存，則可能被納入剩餘財產計算，成為離婚時另一半依法請求分配的關鍵。

父母贈與、身後繼承股票本金原則上不必分

蘇家宏指出，許多父母會提前替子女規劃財產傳承，透過贈與股票或遺產繼承，將資產交到下一代手中，但也擔心子女日後離婚，辛苦累積的家產因此遭到分配。以父母送給兒子10張台積電股票為例，如果股票是父母生前直接贈與，或父母過世後由兒子繼承取得，這類財產屬於無償取得，依照民法第1030條之1規定，原則上排除於夫妻剩餘財產差額分配的計算範圍之外。因此，即使兒子日後與妻子離婚，這10張股票本身通常不必拿出來與配偶平分。

真正要注意的是股利

不過，股票本金不列入分配，不代表持有股票產生的所有收益都能完全排除。蘇家宏提醒，若兒子持有這10張台積電股票多年，期間領取的股利、股息沒有花掉，而是持續累積留存，這部分收益就可能被納入夫妻剩餘財產的計算。換句話說，父母贈與或繼承的股票本金，與婚後持有期間產生的收益，在財產分配上可能有不同的法律處理方式。若股利長期累積成為可計算的婚後財產，離婚時另一方就有機會依法主張分配差額。

news.Title: 全台首檔美國黃金礦業ETF來了！兆豐「009832」今上市 翻紅小漲1%內
news.Content:
收盤更新

台灣首檔聚焦美國黃金礦業的ETF正式登場！兆豐投信發行的兆豐美國黃金礦業ETF（009832）今（29）日掛牌上市，在台股大盤走弱跌近千點之際，首日股價表現相對抗跌，以9.92元開出後逐步走高翻紅，盤中最高觸及10.01元，上漲0.04元、漲幅0.4%。

一次布局58檔金銀礦業股 黃金、白銀權重9比1

009832為國內首檔聚焦美國金礦企業的ETF，追蹤「NYSE TIP美國黃金礦業指數」，成分涵蓋58檔美股掛牌的黃金、白銀礦業企業，提供投資人參與金銀礦業的管道。

兆豐投信表示，全球科技股與台股近期自高點回落，10月以來至26日，費城半導體指數下跌12.2%，台股同期回檔4.0%。在科技股震盪、外資匯出使新台幣承壓的環境下，分散單一市場曝險的重要性提高。黃金礦業資產與美股大盤相關係數僅0.15，可作為多元配置的選項，投資人可依自身風險承受度評估分批布局。

兆豐投信指出，全球央行自2020年起掀起購金熱潮，反映儲備資產多元化、「去美元化」及避險需求。隨著央行與機構法人調整資產結構，黃金在長線配置中的角色受到重視，相關需求也成為觀察黃金礦業發展的重要因素。

在企業獲利方面，兆豐投信以麵包店為例說明，金價如同商品售價，當售價上升、成本控制得宜，利潤空間便有機會擴大，進一步反映在礦業公司的獲利與股價。009832的黃金、白銀相關企業權重約為9比1，除黃金題材外，白銀也受惠於AI資料中心、太陽能及國防航太等應用需求；單一成分股權重上限為20%，以分散個別公司的投資風險。

《Yahoo股市》提醒，透過ETF布局美股掛牌礦業企業，可省去自行保管實體黃金的需求，並以證券交易方式參與相關產業。不過，黃金礦業ETF投資的是企業股票，表現除受金銀價格影響，也與公司營運及成本變化有關。投資人可將其納入整體資產配置評估，兼顧產業成長機會與風險分散。009832經理年費為0.68%、保管年費為0.15%，收益評價月分為每年3月及9月底，採半年配息機制。

news.Title: What Microsoft (MSFT) Said on Its Q1 Earnings Call
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Microsoft Corporation? Here are five stocks we like better.

Microsoft reported a strong fiscal Q1: Revenue rose 19% to $92.3 billion, while Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 30% to $63.9 billion and EPS grew 18% to $4.89.

AI and Azure demand remained robust: Azure revenue grew 48%, Foundry revenue more than tripled, and Copilot usage expanded sharply, though customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.

Microsoft is accelerating infrastructure spending: Capital expenditures totaled $45.2 billion in the quarter and are expected to exceed $50 billion in Q2, while the company forecast 18%–19% total revenue growth for the second quarter.

Why Rising Rates Could Break the Bull Market Before AI Spending Can Save It

Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) reported a fast start to fiscal 2027, with first-quarter revenue of $92.3 billion, up 19% from a year earlier, as demand for cloud infrastructure and artificial intelligence services lifted results above the company's expectations.

Chief Financial Officer Amy Hood said operating income increased 21%, while earnings per share rose 18% to $4.89. Microsoft Cloud revenue reached $63.9 billion, growing 30%, with growth accelerating from the prior quarter. The company's operating margin increased slightly to 50% despite continued spending on AI infrastructure, research and development, and talent.

→ Comfort Systems Earnings: AI Slowdown or More Growth Ahead?

Buy the Dip: 4 Stocks the Market Marked Down Too Far Ahead of Big Catalysts

"Our results exceeded expectations across revenue, operating income, and earnings per share, driven by strong demand across the Microsoft Cloud," Hood said.

Azure growth and AI demand

Azure revenue rose 48% year over year, exceeding Microsoft's expectations despite delays in some third-party capacity deliveries. Hood attributed the performance to Foundry, Microsoft's platform for building and deploying AI agents, as well as improved monetization of CPU capacity.

→ A 70% Rally Isn't Chord Energy's Only Selling Point

Not All Tech Is Getting Crushed: 5 Names Holding Up Through the AI Sell-Off

Foundry revenue more than tripled from a year earlier, while the number of Foundry customers exceeded 120,000. Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella said customers are increasingly using the platform to build agentic systems that connect models, data and business workflows. Revenue from open-source models on Foundry increased tenfold, while the number of customers using multiple models for agentic solutions grew fivefold.

Story Continues

Nadella said Microsoft's AI strategy centers on delivering a connected stack that spans infrastructure, data, agent-building tools, workplace software and security. He described the company's Copilot offerings as "the new OS for work," saying daily users increased nearly 50% sequentially and more than fivefold year over year.

→ Not All Tech Is Getting Crushed: 5 Names Holding Up Through the AI Sell-Off

Microsoft also said the number of customers with more than 50,000 Copilot seats rose more than eightfold year over year. Volkswagen, for example, announced plans to deploy Copilot to more than 330,000 employees, according to Nadella.

Usage-based demand is also growing. The number of Copilot customers actively consuming credits through usage-based billing increased more than 75% during the quarter. On GitHub, agent-generated pull requests increased sixfold in the past six months and now account for more than one-third of pull requests on the platform, Nadella said.

Infrastructure investment and capacity constraints

Microsoft spent $45.2 billion on capital expenditures during the quarter, although Hood said some expected third-party capacity deliveries were delayed. Roughly three-quarters of the spending went toward short-lived assets, primarily CPUs and GPUs, including memory and storage.

The company added 24 data centers across five continents during the quarter and said it reduced dock-to-live times for new GB300 systems in its largest regions by about 20% sequentially. Microsoft also increased throughput for Copilot workloads by more than 50% from the prior quarter.

For the second quarter, Microsoft expects capital expenditures to exceed $50 billion. Calendar-year spending is expected to be about $170 billion, with spending accelerating in the second half as delayed third-party capacity arrives along with additional CPU and GPU deployments.

Hood said customer demand for Azure continues to exceed available supply. She said engineering improvements across GPUs, CPUs, storage, memory and application layers allowed Microsoft to allocate more capacity to Foundry customers during the first quarter. Higher-than-expected token pricing for certain AI models also benefited revenue.

Microsoft expects Azure revenue growth of 49% to 50% in constant currency in the second quarter. Hood cautioned that quarterly growth may vary based on infrastructure efficiency gains, new capacity additions, model mix and the timing of large commitments.

Commercial products and consumer trends

Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud revenue increased 18%, or 19% in constant currency after adjusting for a prior-year comparison. The company cited stronger GitHub Copilot adoption and usage, partly offset by weaker sales execution for Microsoft 365 E3 and standalone products.

Paid Microsoft 365 commercial seats rose 5%, with expansion primarily in small and midsize businesses and frontline worker offerings. Hood said growth in the commercial cloud business was driven by both average revenue per user and seat growth, with premium products including Microsoft 365 Copilot, E5 and E7 contributing to pricing gains.

Devices and Consumer revenue fell 3% to $15.5 billion. Windows OEM and Devices revenue declined 22%, while Windows OEM revenue fell 27%, reflecting the prior-year benefit from Windows 10 end-of-support demand, inventory drawdowns by OEMs and channel partners, and weaker PC-market demand.

Xbox revenue declined 2%, as growth in first-party content was offset by lower third-party content and Game Pass revenue. Search and advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs rose 12%, driven by higher volume and rates across LinkedIn, Edge and Bing.

Second-quarter outlook

Microsoft forecast total second-quarter revenue of $96 billion to $97.1 billion, representing growth of 18% to 19%. It expects Agents and Infra revenue of $80.1 billion to $80.7 billion, up 24% to 25%.

Microsoft 365 Commercial Cloud growth is expected to be about 19% in constant currency.

Search and advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs is expected to grow at a low-double-digit rate.

Xbox Content and Services revenue is expected to increase in the mid- to high-single digits, supported by content launches.

Windows OEM and Devices revenue is expected to decline in the mid-30% range amid elevated inventory and softer PC demand.

Microsoft expects second-quarter operating expenses to rise about 9%, as it continues investing in R&D, compute capacity and talent. Hood said the company expects operating margin to decline slightly from the prior year, while remaining free-cash-flow positive for fiscal 2027.

About Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT)

Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) is a global technology company that develops software, cloud services, devices and digital platforms. Its products and services are used by consumers, businesses, governments and educational institutions worldwide.

The company's principal offerings include the Windows operating system; Microsoft 365 productivity applications such as Word, Excel, Teams and Outlook; Azure cloud computing and infrastructure services; Dynamics business applications; and enterprise security solutions.

news.Title: 8檔台股高息ETF今年來含息績效勝大盤 00927漲幅居冠
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-29 11:55:17 新聞中心 發佈

台股今年來累計漲幅約6成，也帶動台股ETF績效表現，特別是去年一直被投資人嚴格檢視的台股高息ETF績效也大躍進。統計至昨(28)日為止，25檔台股高息ETF今年來含息表現平均57.57%，以單檔來看，統計有包括群益半導體收益（00927）、群益科技高息成長（00946）、統一台灣高息動能（00939）、國泰永續高股息（00878）、復華台灣科技優息（00929）、大華優利高填息30（00918）、元大高股息（0056）、凱基優選30（00938）等，共8檔今年來含息績效打敗大盤。其中，以群益半導體收益上漲94.95%漲幅居冠。

市場法人表示，要能抵禦台股市場的波動度，建議配置中要有高息ETF，而在AI、科技股領軍下推升台股續揚，台股科技型高息ETF更可期待息利雙收。投資人可適度配置擁有科技前景又有息收保護的高息ETF，能兼顧收益，又有科技產業發展前景的潛在價差空間可期。

據了解，00927的持股鎖定半導體中的高息龍頭股，以追成長、重市值、真高息三大訴求構成選股策略金三角，透過100%布局半導體產業來掌握成長機會，並在考量股利發放總額的前提下，篩選出市值大的半導體龍頭股，再依據最新股利公告精準鎖定當中的高息股，以此兼顧投資組合的成長性與股息力。

群益半導體收益暨群益台灣精選高息ETF（00919）ETF經理人謝明志表示，高息股的誘因除了穩定領息之外，跟漲抗跌的特性也是重點之一，意味著若面臨市況震盪加劇的窘境，高息股表現仍相對具韌性，同時在多頭期間 也能順勢攀揚，進可攻、退可守，為追求穩健存股之投資人可考量採納的投資工具。隨著台灣在半導體核心技術、高階晶片製程等領域地位越加關鍵，預期AI外溢效應將持續發酵，有望挹注台股企業成長動能，因此樂觀看待台股第四季表現。

群益科技高息成長ETF經理人洪祥益指出，短線大盤仍受美伊衝突後續發展、大型雲端服務供應商財報與資本支出計劃、聯準會利率會議所牽動，不過，AI相關科技產業及其供應鏈持續成為台股成長的主要動能，中長線仍看好基本面強勁之AI概念類股，在投資布局方面，可聚焦基本面穩健、具護城河優勢的產業龍頭，掌握AI長期成長動能。

news.Title: 台股下殺轉空了？杜金龍爆真相  欣興、南亞5檔拉回就買
news.Content:
台股持續在46K至48K之間震盪，權值股無力使達陣5萬點的目標必須延後，分析師杜金龍對台股後市仍有信心，明年5月台股53K的預測不變，並分享目前對於台積電、台達電、聯發科、欣興、CCL及台塑集團的看法。

權值股受壓抑 搶先押注明年噴發？

杜金龍於理財節目《T台最錢線》認為，目前大盤依然處於主升段，10月修正主因是美國選舉前的觀望情緒、外資大幅賣超以及政治與消息面的刻意壓盤，等到美國大選與台灣九合一選舉陸續結束後，有望一路成長至明年，並搭配元旦、春節與元宵行情，且歷史統計第四季末至第一季上漲機率高達67%至70%。

權值股台積電、台達電與聯發科走勢受到壓抑，杜金龍認為，台積電2400元附近仍是很好的機會，且已經觀察到資金強力護盤跡象；聯發科若摔至4000元以下為不錯的買點，持有台達電的朋友不用太擔心，但若想要進場仍要控制資金水位，應該分批並觀察。

熱門股又該怎麼選？名師解答

除了權值股之外，杜金龍看好欣興後市，基本面不是問題，且已經從高點約1400元下跌超過40%，千元附近存在低接的機會；銅箔基板CCL族群方面，短線首選聯茂，因為股價相對便宜，近期股價極為活潑，適合短線操作。

長線上，杜金龍仍青睞台光電，CCL龍頭指標預估今年EPS約31元，明年上看61元，基本面獲利翻倍，長線看好。記憶體族群中，杜金龍點名南亞科、旺宏，南亞科長線上有衝千金的實力，續抱不賣；旺宏回落後不建議在低檔砍單，建議抱到明年5月或2028年。

最後，杜金龍提到台塑集團輪流發動的氣勢，南亞的動向備受關注，外資的目標價已經看到400元之上，當大盤拉回時存在分批進場的機會。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】台股跌逾800點失守季線　電子半導體走弱
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年10月29日電）美國聯邦準備理事會（Fed）宣布最新利率決策按兵不動，市場持續消化經濟前景與科技股財報訊息。台股今天開低震盪，早盤賣壓湧現，盤中最低下探46146點、下跌逾800點，失守季線約46502點，代表中小型股的櫃買指數早盤一度衝高，隨後翻黑走弱。

至10時54分，加權指數達到46330.67點，下跌704.91點，跌幅1.5%，成交值新台幣4706.09億元。

電子權值股台積電 (2330) 開低震盪，盤中最低來到2395元，跌幅超過1%；電子及半導體類股指數同步走疲，跌幅超過2%、1.5%；金融指數逆勢上揚超過1%。傳產方面，塑膠類股指數盤中翻黑下跌近1%。

美國聯準會最新決議將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持不變，符合市場多數預期。聯準會重申，將持續關注通膨走勢與就業市場數據，市場觀望氣氛濃厚，壓抑資金追價意願。

觀察盤面焦點，晶圓代工廠聯電 (2303) 盤中觸及跌停115.5元，成交量超過23萬張；面板廠友達 (2409) 由紅翻黑，盤中挫近4%，最低34元。砷化鎵廠穩懋 (3105) 第3季獲利亮眼，每股盈餘4.55元，今天盤中攻漲停594元，成交量逾5萬張。

news.Title: 【Hot台股】南亞科漲逾4%後翻黑！網喊「記憶體剩牙科苦撐」分析師示警上檔有壓力
news.Content:
今日社群台股最Hot議題

「牙科優惠時間結束，10點開拉」、「牙科剛綠的是要載人上車？」、「記憶體剩牙科，苦苦支撐」、「昨天沒買到牙科，悶啊」、「牙科重返500大關了嗎」。

「牙科華崩還撐著欸，太扯」、「牙科這波要破前高嗎」、「誰要便宜的牙科？現在大特價給你啊，還不進場看牙」。

針對網友熱議話題…專家這麼說！

HOT台股今日值班專家－啟發投顧分析師白易弘

記憶體大廠南亞科（2408）今（29）日股價震盪，早盤一度衝上497.5元，漲逾4%，距離500元大關僅差2.5元。隨後翻黑又拉回紅盤，不少股民喊「牙科優惠時間結束，10點開拉」，也有股民表示「記憶體剩牙科苦撐」。

白易弘表示，受到昨晚美股科技及記憶體相關族群收高帶動，南亞科今日早盤開高，但由於股價短線已連續上漲，來到480元至500元附近，正好面臨先前高檔套牢區的賣壓，因此開高後漲幅收斂，盤中一度翻黑。

白易弘指出，南亞科近期漲勢較快，短線出現獲利了結賣壓並不意外，若股價拉回至5日均線附近，支撐可能相對較強。他認為，對於尚未進場的投資人，目前不宜急著追高，可先觀察股價是否回落至440元至450元附近，再評估進場時機。

至於網友關注南亞科能否再攻前高，白易弘認為，目前仍有一定壓力，短線須先站穩500元，才有機會進一步挑戰高點。他指出，下周記憶體廠將陸續公布營收，若營運數據提供支撐，南亞科才比較有機會再度挑戰500元關卡。

湯暖萱／財經特派記者，主跑主計處、營建、百貨紡織等

news.Title: Google跌勢引爆蔓延AI鏈！ 韓股重挫3% 台股跌逾800點
news.Content:
Google母公司Alphabet在29日盤後公布財報，第三季營收來到633億美元、年增12%，但依然遠低於外界預期，在財報不如預期及市場對其資本支出的疑慮升溫，股價盤後一度重挫逾10%，連帶影響其他AI巨頭股價同步下滑，亞股也遭受波及，日經指數由紅翻黑、韓股KOSPI指數跌3%，台股也下跌逾800點。

根據Alphabet公布的財報，第三季搜尋廣告營收達到633億美元，年增12％，但未能達到市場預期的649億美元，被市場視為一大警訊，這代表在AI搜尋模式快速普及下，目前尚未具備與傳統搜尋相當的廣告變現能力，恐影響Google長期仰賴的搜尋廣告主力業務，進一步讓未來營收承壓。

Alphabet財報曝光後，股價盤後一度重挫逾10%，市場對AI的擔憂情緒也蔓延到AI供應鏈，夜盤股價紛紛下跌走弱，AMD、英特爾下跌逾4%，美光、威騰電子、博通下跌逾3%，輝達、SpaceX、特斯拉也下跌逾1%；亞股也未能倖免，韓股KOSPI指數跌逾3%、三星電子重挫6%，日經指數由紅翻黑，在平盤附近震盪，台股也一度重挫逾800點。

針對財報不如預期，Google首席商務官Philipp Schindler表示，匯率逆風是造成本季搜尋廣告成長放緩的最大單一因素，以及歐盟取消最低限額豁免政策衝擊零售廣告主，他坦言，AI模式帶動搜尋量顯著提升，但目前變現率仍偏低，對營收成長造成一定影響；至於自由現金流降至負91億美元，財務長Anat Ashkenazi則表示，TPU系統須先投入現金建立庫存，之後才逐步認列銷售收入，因此會形成現金流與營收認列的時間差，公司仍預期整個投資週期的投入資本報酬率將高於資本成本。

news.Title: 聯電法說變法會「股價打跌停」 智原連拉2漲停
news.Content:
聯電（2303）28日公布第3季財報，營收創單季歷史次高、晶圓出貨量刷新紀錄，還預告2027年平均售價有望成長約10％，並追加32億美元，要布局先進封裝與矽光子。怎料「法說變法會」29日股價開低走低，股價一度打跌停。另一方面，集團旗下智原（3035）股價延續強勢，連拉2根漲停。

第3季營收742億元

聯電第3季合併營收達742.4億元，季增8％、年增25.6％，創單季歷史次高；毛利率34％，營業利益186.4億元，季增24.7％，歸屬母公司淨利164.3億元，每股純益（EPS）1.32元。第3季晶圓出貨量季增7.3％，突破120萬片12吋約當晶圓，創下歷史新高，產能利用率也從第2季的85％提升至92％，部分12吋晶圓廠產能已滿載，8吋晶圓廠營運亦明顯復甦。

展望第4季，聯電預估晶圓出貨量季增1％至3％，美元計價平均售價維持穩健，毛利率約34％，產能利用率則可望維持在91％至93％。執行長王石指出，高階智慧手機、工業應用需求強勁，車用市場也持續復甦，但電腦市場需求相對疲軟。隨著AI基礎建設持續發展，電源管理晶片（PMIC）、現場可程式化邏輯陣列（FPGA）及連接應用需求可望成長。

明年ASP喊漲1成

聯電看好2027年晶圓代工定價環境改善，預期平均售價將較2026年成長約10％，並從明年第1季開始呈現正向成長。然而，財務長劉啟東坦言，晶圓報價調升不代表毛利率就能同步大幅改善，因為原物料成本也在增加，加上未來數年折舊費用將持續上升，預期2027年折舊費用至少呈低個位數成長，2028年增幅可能進一步擴大。

聯電指出，未來至少3年，折舊與原物料成本都將對毛利率形成壓力，即使平均售價上漲，毛利率仍不容易回到過去景氣高峰水準。這也成為市場評估聯電後續獲利的重要變數，投資人關注漲價效益能否抵銷成本增加，以及產能受限後，營收與獲利還能有多少成長空間。

聯電重挫、智原連2根漲停

儘管營運展望不乏亮點，聯電股價仍遭賣壓襲擊。29日盤中最低殺到跌停價115.5元。相較之下，集團旗下智原受惠明年AI營收可望大幅成長，以及成功接獲美系雲端AI應用之大型專案，採用2奈米GAA製程，股價延續強勢，已連續第2個交易日攻上漲停，來到231.5元。

謝金河分析，金融業是貫穿國家經濟發展的任督二脈，當總體經濟走強，金融業自然水漲船高。他回顧台灣金融發展歷程，當前台灣金融業的逾期放款比率與呆帳覆蓋率均處於歷史上最健全的優異狀態，這項體質結構的轉變，直接推升了整體金控的股價淨值比（PB）。檢視目前盤面數據，華南金股價淨值比高達2.87倍、玉山金達2.83倍，永豐金與元大金也繳出2.48倍的高水準，中信金則達2.14倍；對比2000年前後扁政府時期，全台銀行業為了全力打呆帳，多數銀行的股價淨值比普遍在0.5以下掙扎，如今整體身價早已不可同日而語。

著中國房地產泡沫吹破，地產巨擘接連破產清算、股價跌至殘值，連帶導致銀行體系呆帳愈滾愈大，直接反映在持續探底的估值上。謝金河特別整理中國42家上市銀行的股價淨值比，發現至今竟沒有任何一家高於1，表現最好的招商銀行也僅有0.93；他直言，若房地產危機無法遏止，加上多數中資銀行尚未真正全面攤提呆帳，未來的壞帳壓力恐將更加惡化，即便中國財政部全力注資救市，民間資本仍透過各種管道爭相「潤」出海外，根本問題始終未解。在此消彼長之際，謝金河看好金管會主委彭金隆積極推動的「亞洲資產管理中心」已浮現絕佳契機。他指出，過去推動這項政策難度極高，但如今台灣民間資金極度充沛、「錢水漲船高」，台灣金融業光是管理本土龐大的民間財富就坐擁難以估量的商機。謝金河借鏡國際局勢指出，近期滙豐銀行（HSBC）財報不如預期引發股價重挫，反觀新加坡星展銀行（DBS）上半

news.Title: 日股ETF氣勢強今年來皆大賺二位數 00951受益人激增奪雙冠王
news.Content:
日本政府積極作多股市，推出多項鼓勵散戶進場政策，如股票分割和降低投資金額，促使家庭資金更容易直接進入日本股市中，加上半導體產業大幅成長，帶動日股屢創新高，展開長達一年的多頭氣勢，也激勵日股ETF強勁的漲升行情，根據統計，9檔國內投信發行的日股ETF今年來皆大漲二位數以上，其中，聚焦半導體產業的台新日本半導體(00951-TW)及中信日本半導體(00954-TW)皆大漲3成以上高居前二名。績效第一的 00951 今年來受益人大增4836人，亦傲視同類型基金。

全球半導體市場劇烈震盪與地緣政治不確定性持續牽動市場投資情緒，觀察今年以來日股ETF受益人數變化，台新日本半導體及中信日本半導體增加人數最多，顯示日本半導體產業最受市場投資人關注，尤其在近期各家半導體設備供應商獲利普遍上修下，反映AI時代對算力需求的大幅提升，也證明AI時代對先進半導體製程設備的需求持續攀升。

台新日本半導體ETF經理人邱麒安表示，日本半導體身為全球半導體重鎮，受惠需求激增，日本半導體製造裝置協會（SEAJ）大幅上修2026年度日本半導體設備銷售額預估值至6.6兆日圓，年增26%，創歷史新高，2026-2028年複合成長率高達13.8%。

雖然日本半導體市況近期隨全球科技股修正而跌幅明顯，但這也為長線投資人創造了絕佳的逢低買進時機。隨著 AI 與高速運算需求持續擴張，加上日本首相積極落實振興財政，大規模補強在地半導體自主供應鏈，高純度的日本半導體材料與設備廠將迎來長線復甦，此時的價格回檔正是結構性布局的黃金買點。

news.Title: 台股昨日狂飆、今反手殺逾700點！4萬7得而復失，短線支撐受考驗
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃冠豪】亞洲股市今日早盤漲跌分歧，受到聯準會維持利率不變，以及美股費城半導體指數上漲1.76%激勵，日、韓半導體股持續受到資金青睞。韓國KOSPI指數早盤一度上漲84.10點、漲幅1.40%，來到6,096.54點，但盤中翻跌急殺3%，使亞股全面下殺。日本日經225指數力撐漲勢，早盤一度漲約0.79%，來到64,460點附近，鎧俠、軟銀等科技股成為撐盤主力。台股早盤開低殺跌出現明顯回檔。加權指數昨日大漲939.35點，收在47,035.58點，今日以47,014.87點開出後，受到聯電(2303)為首電子權值股賣壓影響，跌幅迅速擴大，盤中一度重挫超過700點，回測46,200點附近，47,000點整數關卡再度失守。櫃買指數早盤則一度小幅上漲，部分中小型題材股仍有買盤支撐，顯示資金並未全面撤出市場。

權值股方面，台積電(2330)開盤下跌5元，報2,420元，早盤最低來到2,400元，跌幅約0.41%；聯發科(2454)昨日強彈6.94%，今日下殺5%。聯電(2303)雖然釋出2027年平均售價成長10%的展望，但股價不漲反跌，一度打入跌停。台達電(2308)最低1,430元，下跌逾7%；光學股大立光(3008)同步走弱，玉晶光(3406)跌停，反映高價電子股獲利了結壓力。

熱門族群方面，PCB與CCL相對抗跌，PCB材料設備族群早盤上漲約2.04%，亞泰金屬(6727)攻上漲停，達航科技(4577)漲逾7%。高階銅箔基板龍頭台光電(2383)盤中上漲超過3%，台燿(6274)、聯茂(6213)也力撐平盤附近，顯示AI伺服器高速傳輸需求仍是重要支撐。ABF載板族群則觀察欣興(3037)、景碩(3189)、南電(8046)能否延續昨日反彈，尤其景碩昨日攻上漲停，短線須留意追價買盤能否持續。被動元件方面，國巨*(2327)、華新科(2492)、禾伸堂(3026)仍是市場觀察指標，族群經過昨日反攻後，今日需留意高檔調節壓力。

整體而言，台股昨日急漲近千點，今日隨即出現回檔，顯示短線籌碼尚未完全穩定。後續觀察46600點附近能否形成有效支撐，以及台積電能否止跌、櫃買指數能否維持相對強勢。若PCB、CCL及矽光子族群買盤延續，仍有機會支撐盤面輪動，但短線不宜過度追價，應留意成交量與權值股走勢變化。

news.Title: 〈房產〉台積電效應發酵！高雄租屋熱區三民區連4年稱冠 楠梓區升至第二
news.Content:
台積電(2330-TW)擴大在半導體S廊帶的投資，使高雄租屋熱區也出現變化。房仲業者根據高雄市地政局億年旺網站資料統計，至今年5月，高雄市租屋熱區第一名，由三民區奪冠，三民區租屋件數占全市比例達17.3%，且自該網站2023年統計以來，三民區已連續四年蟬聯冠軍。

排名第二為楠梓區，進一步觀察，楠梓區2023年時全市排名僅在第五位，近年來一路爬升，已連續兩年穩居第二。其他包括苓雅、左營與鳳山區，均入榜前五大租屋熱區。

台灣房屋集團趨勢中心經理李家妮表示，三民區腹地廣、人口基數大，區內住宅供給選擇性多元，擁有車站商圈、高醫、陽明、後驛等多個成熟生活圈，部分區段具備捷運、輕軌機能，並擁有大型醫院，高醫大、文藻、高科大等多所大學城，加上三民區房價水位為市區中相對親民的區域，因此長期累積了穩定的上班族與學生租屋需求支撐，無論房屋買賣或租賃市場，均具有一定的市場性支撐。

李家妮指出，近年受惠台積電進駐高雄，帶動科技產業廊帶成形，除了挹注就業機會，也為周邊住宅、廠辦及商用不動產租賃帶來新的需求，從南高雄的亞灣區串連至北高雄的台積電產業聚落，觀察2026年高雄15個主要行政區中，就約有7成區域，包括楠梓、左營、新興、小港等區，租屋熱度均較往年增加。

其中楠梓區，原就有加工區產業及高大特區需求支撐，近年再受惠台積電設廠效應，帶動區域就業與居住需求升溫，尤其在2025年進入裝機量產後，就業人力陸續進駐，部分外地就業族群為保有工作轉換與居住安排的彈性，前期多會傾向先以租代買，偏好鎖定鄰近產業園區、交通便捷及生活機能成熟的區域，以縮短通勤時間、降低居住成本，進而推升該區租屋市場熱度。

進一步觀察今年高雄市住宅租屋偏好，以住宅大樓及整棟（戶）出租為熱門類型，且租賃佔比均呈現上升趨勢，其次為獨立套房，占比約2成，但較往年下滑約1.5個百分點；租客來源有約2成是來自於外縣市，主要來自於屏東、台南及台北市。

台灣房屋高鐵重愛加盟店店東陳揚智表示，以三民區、楠梓區來說，過去有不少透天隔間套房、雅房，因租金相對親民，深受學生及單身上班族青睞，近年隨著台積電設廠與產業建設帶動周邊房市發展，新大樓供給增加，大樓租賃案件也隨之成長。以台積電廠區周邊兩房大樓，月租金約在2- 2.3萬元，雖然租金高於公寓及透天隔套產品，但因具備電梯管理、休閒娛樂公設，整體居住品質及便利性，更受科技就業族群青睞。

陳揚智表示，近年高雄房價處於相對高檔，加上限貸令實施後，資金壓力與購屋門檻提高，同時考量租金補貼紅利，都可能讓部分小資購屋族，選擇先以租代買，以降低短期居住成本，為符合家庭客群，整層2-3房的大樓租件需求也相對擴大。

news.Title: Cash is king as investors draw new battle lines in AI spending boom
news.Content:
By Aditya Soni and Deborah Mary Sophia

Oct 29 (Reuters) - Cash flow is king again.

Wall Street rewarded Microsoft and Oracle on Wednesday for showing that they could fund their enormous AI ambitions without endlessly tapping investors.

Alphabet, by contrast, was punished for burning through cash, while Google Search's ‌slower growth fanned fears that competition was hurting the business that bankrolls its AI expansion.

Microsoft shares jumped more than 3% in after-hours trading, while ‌Alphabet plunged nearly 10%, as investors drew a sharper distinction between companies making money from AI and those struggling to contain its costs.

The divergence shows that after rewarding companies for spending aggressively to secure ​computing capacity — often through debt — investors are demanding more evidence that the resulting growth can finance the next round of outlays.

Meta offered an early warning last week, when better-than-expected revenue growth and an upbeat outlook were eclipsed by its cash burn. Oracle, on the other hand, ended regular trading nearly 11% higher on Wednesday after Larry Ellison's company said it was planning to put a ceiling on external financing and expected to turn its cash flow positive in the second half of fiscal 2028.

"Alphabet and Microsoft were night ‌and day," said Melissa Otto, head of research at ⁠S&P Global Visible Alpha.

"Microsoft's quarter demonstrated very disciplined growth, whereas Google is burning cash and its core business came in below expectations," she said, adding that it may lead investors to question "is AI taking some share" from Google Search.

Google's search revenue grew 12% ⁠in the September quarter but fell short of expectations for a 14.7% increase, even as CEO Sundar Pichai said queries were growing at their fastest pace in five years.

The long-lucrative business is under threat from AI chatbots and agents that are changing how people search for information, just as the company pours more money into the technology. Capital expenditure will increase ​significantly ​in 2027, CFO Anat Ashkenazi told analysts.

CLOUD BOOM, CASH SQUEEZE

Alphabet's eyebrow-raising capital outlay — with as much ​as $205 billion expected this year — is, however, driving gains at ‌Google's other major AI business.

Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.71 billion, but Alphabet's spending overwhelmed that growth. Cash burn hit $9.07 billion after the company posted its first quarter of negative cash flow in the June period.

"This is definitely a different business, Google. It's a different business today than it was three, five, 10 years ago," said Jeremy Saltzberg, vice president and senior investment officer at Check Capital, which owns Alphabet shares.

Story Continues

Saltzberg pushed back on the concerns about spending, saying Alphabet needed to have big outlays to stay competitive at a time when OpenAI and Anthropic appear to be pulling ahead in Silicon Valley's AI model race.

"We think this is a sport ‌of kings, which is that if you don't have $150 billion to spend next year on ​capital expenditure, don't even bother showing up," Saltzberg said.

MICROSOFT'S CASH FLOW ADVANTAGE

Microsoft offered a stark contrast. The ​company generated $18.6 billion in free cash flow in its fiscal first quarter, ​nearly $10 billion more than Wall Street expected, even as it poured $45.2 billion into expanding its computing infrastructure.

Revenue at its Azure cloud business ‌surged a better-than-expected 48% and the company forecast faster-than-expected cloud ​growth for the current quarter, suggesting corporate demand ​for AI computing remains strong.

The results also suggested Microsoft was finding a broader market for AI beyond a handful of deep-pocketed customers, including OpenAI, whose heavy computing requirements have fueled the industry's expansion.

"The shiny object stuff is waning" as more businesses move beyond experimenting with the newest or most powerful ​AI models and commit to long-term contracts, Microsoft CEO Satya ‌Nadella said in a conference call with analysts.

"I want the breadth," he said. "We have large customers who want to buy from us ... As ​long as the pricing is right, we may sell them some. If not, we will be patient about building the breadth business."

(Reporting by ​Aditya Soni and Deborah Sophia in Bengaluru; Editing by Sayantani Ghosh and Thomas Derpinghaus)

news.Title: Asian shares fall as Alphabet earnings miss drags Wall St futures lower
news.Content:
By Stella Qiu

SYDNEY, Oct 29 (Reuters) - Asian shares gave up earlier gains on Thursday as AI-related earnings announcements prompted wildly mixed responses, raising the stakes for Amazon and Intel results due later in the day.

Hefty cash burn from Alphabet sent its shares ‌10% lower in after-hours trading, wiping nearly $400 billion off its market value. That drove Nasdaq futures 1% lower. Microsoft, by contrast, ‌beat forecasts with better-than-expected cash flows that lifted its shares by 3%.

Overnight, the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady as widely expected, but two committee members voted for a hike. Chair ​Kevin Warsh struck a more confident note on the inflation outlook during his press conference, sparking a rally in Treasuries.

However, the bigger test came from earnings. Samsung Electronics said on Thursday its operating profit rose nearly ninefold to a record high in the third quarter, driven by robust demand for AI chips. Its shares still slid more than 4% and dragged the broader KOSPI index down 2.6% after a nearly 7% surge a day earlier.

MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific ‌shares outside Japan dropped 0.7%, while Japan's Nikkei trimmed ⁠gains to be up 0.3%.

Mainland China's blue chips fell 0.9% and Hong Kong's Hang Seng index rose 0.2%.

"The reason why Alphabet is down is because their traditional revenue service of ad generation has been impacted by the very thing ⁠which is the AI boom. So it's causing a mix of results for Google," said Jamie Hannah, deputy head of investments at VanEck.

"Both of Alphabet and Microsoft confirmed that the AI revenue generation is still solid. We saw that through the data center growth, the cloud services. So that part of the business is solid, ​which ​then flows into a lot of the information coming out of Asia with SK ​Hynix yesterday as well in Korea."

Shares of SK Hynix ‌rose 1.3% after jumping 11% a day earlier on strong earnings.

CENTRAL BANK FEST CONTINUES

After the Fed held interest rates steady, all eyes are on US Personal Consumption Expenditures data for September, the Fed's preferred gauge of inflation. Forecasts are centred on a 0.3% monthly rise in the core measure, picking up from a 0.2% gain the previous month.

Markets are still 80% priced for a rate rise in December despite dovish comments from Warsh, which led to a steepening of the Treasury yield curve. The 2-year Treasury yield fell 6 basis points overnight and was last flat at 4.6933%.

"The dissenting votes to ‌hike rates at today's meeting could be interpreted as being not about whether the ​Fed hikes again, but when," said Kerry Craig, global market strategist at J.P. Morgan Asset ​Management.

Story Continues

"With policy tightening already being priced in, this implies that yields ​will remain range-bound unless there is a clearer signal for more aggressive policy tightening or a pivot to cuts," ‌he said.

The Bank of Canada hiked interest rates on Wednesday ​for the first time in more than ​three years and warned of further increases. The European Central Bank is, however, expected to hold interest rates steady later on Thursday.

In the currency markets, the dollar was steady against its major peers after a 0.2% dip overnight. The kiwi was nursing heavy losses at $0.5626, ​having slid 1% overnight as its central bank shocked ‌markets by leaving interest rates steady on Wednesday.

Brent crude futures fell 0.4% on Thursday to $114.91 a barrel after the Wall Street ​Journal reported US Vice President JD Vance sent a letter to Iranian Security Council chief Mohsen Rezaei in an effort ​to revive peace negotiations.

(Reporting by Stella Qiu in Sydney; Editing by Jamie Freed)

news.Title: 被聯電拖累！00927等「4檔台股ETF」臉綠 最重跌近3%
news.Content:
晶圓代工大廠聯電（2303）昨日召開法說會，公布第三季每股盈餘 1.32 元，並宣布追加逾千億台幣資本支出強攻先進封裝與矽光子技術，可龐大資本支出引發市場對折舊衝擊毛利率的疑慮，股價今天跌破半根停板，同步重創群益00927在內等4檔高含聯電 ETF表現，最重跌近3％，分析師莊佳螢指出，資本支出的利多效益仍需要時間沉澱與發酵，聯電短線反彈壓力較大。不過考量股價已大幅拉回，建議手中有個股或相關 ETF 的投資人無須急於此刻殺低，可觀察後續築底狀況再行打算。

聯電昨日（28）召開法說會並公布第三季財報。受上一季高基期影響，第三季歸屬母公司淨利為 164.3 億元，季減 61%，但仍較去年同期成長 12%，單季每股盈餘（EPS）為 1.32 元。此外，聯電董事會亦同步核准追加約 32 億美元（折合新台幣逾千億元）資本支出，宣示全力強攻先進封裝與「矽光子」等前瞻關鍵技術。

龐大的資本支出利多卻未能激勵市場信心，聯電今（29）日開低走低，盤中重挫逾9%至116元，一舉摜破5日線、10日線與季線等多條重要均線。回顧聯電股價才於9月22日創下168.5元高點，短短兩個月內已修正逾三成，今日盤中低點更刷新8月下旬以來的新低紀錄。

聯電今日爆量殺盤，也同步重創其他聯電高含量ETF表現。其中，聯電持股比重高達19.06% 的永豐台灣ESG（00888）盤中重挫 2.74%；持股比重均超過16%的兆豐台灣晶圓製造（00913）與第一金工業菁英30（00728），盤中也雙雙跌逾 2%，另外，群益半導體收益（00927）持股約 8.63%，跌幅也超過2%。

在一片半導體慘綠之中，僅有國泰股利精選30（00701）展現抗跌韌性。儘管該檔 ETF 含有約 13% 的聯電持股，但受惠於成分股中其他高股息與防禦型標的支撐，盤中表現逆勢抗跌，成為今日相關概念 ETF 中的少數亮點。

對於聯電法說會上利多不漲反重挫的走勢，摩爾投顧分析師莊佳螢分析，市場主要顧慮的是龐大資本支出帶來的副作用。大筆資金投入後，隨之而來的設備折舊攤提將直接衝擊明年的毛利率表現，進而壓抑 EPS 成長空間，因此利多效益仍需要時間沉澱與發酵。

莊佳螢指出，在折舊壓力與毛利率受壓的雙重干擾下，聯電短線要快速強勢反彈壓力較大，投資人恐面臨較高的時間成本。不過，考量到股價短線已大幅拉回，建議手中有聯電持股或相關ETF的投資人無須急於在此刻殺低，可觀察後續築底狀況再做打算。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股狂飆939點是逃命波？ 陳嘉偉示警「台積電季線恐下彎」 最壞情境曝
news.Content:
台股28日強勢反攻，加權指數大漲939.35點，收在47,035.58點，漲幅達2.04%，不過成交金額僅約7223億元，量能未能同步放大。承通投顧副總陳嘉偉卻對後市提出警告，認為這波上漲可能只是大盤自高點修正逾4000點後的「空頭反彈」，不代表趨勢已經反轉。他直言，若投資人未把握反彈減碼，應重新檢視持股風險，並提醒11月行情可能面臨更大壓力。

陳嘉偉示警M頭風險

陳嘉偉28日在個人 YT頻道 中指出，台股單日大漲近千點，但成交量沒有明顯擴增，量價結構仍有疑慮；櫃買指數表現也相對疲弱。他認為，市場可能形成M頭型態，若後續跌破前波低點的頸線，恐進一步加深修正壓力。他更將當前國際市場環境形容為多重風險交錯，認為亞洲金融風暴、網路泡沫、金融海嘯及歐債危機等歷史經驗，值得投資人引以為戒。不過，這些判斷屬於他的市場分析，後續仍須觀察指數走勢與成交量變化。

台積電季線恐轉為反壓

陳嘉偉特別關注台積電（2330）的技術面。他指出，台積電近期股價表現相對大盤疲弱，外資賣壓也成為市場關注焦點。由於季線計算涉及過去股價，隨著高檔扣抵值移動，若扣抵位置高於目前股價，季線可能轉為下彎，形成上檔壓力。

他並引用台積電過去季線下彎期間的歷史經驗，指出股價曾分別下跌32.6%及46.2%，作為評估風險的參考。若以台股49,968點高點試算，指數下跌32.6%將來到約33,678點；若下跌46.2%，則可能下探約26,882點，接近他所指的5年線位置。上述數字是依特定跌幅推算的情境，並非對未來指數的確定預測。

科技巨頭財報牽動後市

除了技術面，陳嘉偉也將AI產業投資列為潛在風險。他認為，美國科技巨頭面臨兩難：若持續擴大資本支出，市場可能質疑企業融資及投資回收能力；若放慢投資腳步，又可能引發AI成長動能減弱、泡沫疑慮升高的擔憂。此外，資料中心建設進度、融資成本及AI應用的商業化成果，都將影響市場對科技股的評價。

他也提醒，微軟、Google及亞馬遜等科技巨頭的財報與資本支出展望，將是後續重要觀察指標。整體而言，台股雖然出現強勁反彈，但成交量、台積電季線走勢、外資動向及AI產業投資效益，仍是判斷行情能否延續的關鍵。投資人應審慎評估風險，避免僅憑單日大漲就認定多頭行情已全面回歸。

news.Title: Nvidia's $3 billion Meta bet reveals a 30-fold shift
news.Content: Nvidia (NVDA) is putting $3 billion into Meta Platforms (META). But the size of that check may be less important than what it says about Nvidia itself. The chipmaker bought $42.4 billion of equity securities during the first half of its fiscal 2027, up from just $1.25 billion a year earlier. That is more than a 30-fold increase. Nvidia's July 26 regulatory filing showed $99 billion in equity investments and $25 billion in commitments. Nvidia said it intends those investments to expand growth opportunities, cultivate its ecosystem, and strengthen its competitive position. This development means that the Meta deal is a component of a much bigger change. Nvidia sold more powerful graphics processor chips to establish its supremacy in AI. Nvidia is now utilizing the exceptional income generated from those sales to fund the businesses, infrastructure, and suppliers that could ultimately define the size of the AI industry. To put it another way, Nvidia is no longer only offering the picks and shovels of the AI boom. It is contributing increasingly to the financing of the gold rush. Nvidia puts $3 billion behind a major customer The Muse family of models and Meta's artificial intelligence helper are being developed further, according to Nvidia and Meta. According to Reuters , Nvidia will contribute $3 billion to Meta's share offering as part of that deal. The investment is only one aspect of the relationship. For its next generation of AI agents, Meta intends to increase the use of Nvidia's Vera Rubin systems and Vera central processing units. Additionally, it will make use of BlueField-4 technology and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking from Nvidia. Also read: AI chips are getting so hot, diamonds may be the answer Nvidia said the companies will work together to improve the performance and cost of training and running Meta's Muse models. As a result, an odd bond is formed. At the same time that Meta is increasing its usage of Nvidia technology, Nvidia is investing in Meta. For Nvidia, the $3 billion investment is doable. In the most recent quarter, the company's net income was $59.7 billion. This has more strategic relevance. In addition to generating up to $97.5 billion via a mix of stock issues and a planned future share-sale program, Meta is in the midst of a massive AI infrastructure buildout. Reuters reports that Nvidia, Broadcom (AVGO), and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) have shown interest in investing up to $5 billion in Meta's Class A shares, including Nvidia's $3 billion pledge. Story Continues In the end, Nvidia may be able to meet the demand for the infrastructure it supplies by helping Meta fund that growth. Nvidia is building an investment portfolio around AI demand Meta is by no means the only business that receives funding from Nvidia. In January, Nvidia invested $2 billion in CoreWeave (CRWV) as the cloud provider works toward building more than 5 gigawatts of AI data-center capacity by 2030. Nvidia's infrastructure is a major component of CoreWeave. Nvidia followed that with a $2 billion investment in Nebius Group (NBIS) in March. By the end of 2030, Nebius intends to implement over 5 gigawatts of Nvidia-based AI infrastructure. Additionally, Nvidia has contributed $2 billion to both Lumentum (LITE) and Coherent (COHR). These businesses provide the optical technology required to transfer massive volumes of data between processors and servers in AI data centers. The pattern is important. CoreWeave and Nebius may expand the infrastructure using Nvidia processors. Lumentum and Coherent can expand the technologies available to link such infrastructure. Meta is able to develop AI services and solutions that call for ever-more-powerful computing. Nvidia is at the center of all this. This strategy provides the business with more leverage to increase demand for AI: funding. Nvidia can afford to finance its own ecosystem Few companies could pursue this strategy at Nvidia's scale. Nvidia reported $96.2 billion in second-quarter revenue, up 106% from a year earlier. Data center revenue reached $89 billion, up 117%. Net income was $59.7 billion. Nvidia also generated $74.4 billion of operating cash flow during the first six months of fiscal 2027. Nvidia had $42.8 billion in marketable stock securities and $56.6 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable debt securities at the end of July. More Nvidia: Nvidia stock flashes massive signal as Wall Street leans in Nvidia's AI boom revives a Warren Buffett warning for investors Nvidia puts $500 billion on the table, challenges banking as we know it The equities portfolio has expanded quickly. At the end of January, marketable equity securities were worth barely $12.9 billion. Nvidia continues to provide stockholders enormous financial returns. Despite a sharp rise in investment activities, it spent $39.8 billion repurchasing shares in the first half of fiscal 2027. For investors, that combination is important. Currently, Nvidia does not have to decide between investing in businesses throughout the AI ecosystem and repurchasing its shares. It can accomplish both thanks to its cash generation. Nvidia's strategy also creates a new risk There's a catch. When a chip provider invests in companies that purchase its chips, it blurs the lines between organic demand and ecosystem finance. Investor worries around so-called circular funding in the AI sector have already been heightened by these developments. The fact that Nvidia's investments inevitably generate false demand is not the problem. Businesses like Meta already invest a lot of money in computer infrastructure and make significant profits irrespective of their partnerships with Nvidia. However, the financial relationships inside the AI ecosystem are becoming more intricate. Nvidia is aware of the danger. To boost growth prospects and improve its competitive position, it has made pledges and investments across the ecosystem, according to its most recent filing. Nvidia had $25 billion of future equity investment commitments at the end of July, including $18 billion scheduled for the remainder of fiscal 2027. Additionally, Nvidia is making ever bigger investments in other areas of AI development. Its pledges for supply and capacity increased from $119 billion to $279 billion in July. In addition, the corporation committed to $25 billion in data center leases and $29 billion in cloud services. These figures show how Nvidia is changing from being a chip manufacturer to something much more like an architect and funder of the whole ecosystem of AI infrastructure. If the need for AI continues to grow, that might fortify its competitive moat. Additionally, it suggests that Nvidia has more money invested in the sector's success than ever before. Therefore, investors should also pay attention to Nvidia's GPU revenue. It is the magnitude of Nvidia's investment holdings. The $3 billion Meta investment may soon seem less like a unique transaction and more like Nvidia's new business model if stock commitments and purchases keep rising from today's already remarkable levels. news.Title: 小韭菜退場主力要幹麻？ 達人揭「殘酷對決」：廝殺兇更隱蔽
news.Content:
小韭菜離場不代表風險降低，當市場成交量顯著萎縮、流動性變薄，主力與機構將展開更殘酷的暗處對決。

全球股市成交量顯著降溫

投資達人葉育碩表示，最近市場的熱度，很明顯感受到確實不如前幾個月。成交量縮了，討論區安靜了，連原本天天盯盤的朋友都開始問：「是不是該先觀望一下？」這不只是感覺，數據也說話了。高盛首席美股策略師本·斯奈德（Ben Snider）指出，美國散戶股票交易活躍度較2025年底下降約45%，散戶交易僅占美股總成交量約9%，接近2020年以來最低水平。把鏡頭拉回亞洲，台股成交量從5月單日1.87兆元的歷史天量，到10月28日僅剩約7,200億至7,400億元；A股成交額也從6月峰值3.8兆回落至1.6兆附近；港股南向資金則從持續流入轉為連續11個交易日淨流出。各個市場不約而同地出現同一個訊號：散戶在退場。

主力收割對象向上移階

葉育碩談到，散戶在主力眼裡，說白了就是市場裡的小韭菜。漲的時候追高，跌的時候恐慌，籌碼最容易鬆動，也最容易被收割。韭菜被割完，要長出來也是需要時間的，當這批人陸續離場，市場的韭菜供給自然變少。然而，市場裡那些主力、大戶、機構也就是俗稱的禿鷹，原本靠著收割散戶獲利，現在小韭菜不夠割了，他們會收手嗎？大概率不會，禿鷹的邏輯很簡單，哪裡有肉，就往哪裡去。當散戶退場、成交量萎縮，市場的流動性變薄，價格更容易被資金推動。這時候，主力資金的博弈對象就從散戶，轉向其他機構和大戶，也就是所謂的大韭菜。機構之間的對決，比的是資訊、資金和節奏，猶如神仙打架，廝殺更隱蔽，也更兇狠。換句話說，小韭菜退場不等於市場變安全，而是收割的層級往上移了一階。以前是禿鷹割散戶，現在可能是大禿鷹割小禿鷹，或者機構互割。

操作難度增加觀望也是策略

葉育碩強調，這種時候反而更可怕，因為熱度低，不等於風險低。成交量萎縮、散戶離場，市場看似冷清，但主力資金的博弈可能更集中、更劇烈。籌碼變薄、流動性變差，波動未必變小，甚至可能更難捉摸。也別急著當留下來的大韭菜，如果資金量、資訊面、心理素質都不占優勢，在機構互割的環境裡硬扛，風險不比追高時低。所以說，觀望，也是一種策略，熱度降溫時，現金為王不丟臉。等市場情緒回穩、成交量重新放大，再考慮進場，勝率往往更高

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】美股白漲了？台股失守4萬7大關急墜逾700點 分析師呂漢威：不易回平盤
news.Content:
美股昨日收高，費城半導體指數再度上漲，且Fed決議暫時不升息，不過台股今日早盤卻一度挫逾700點，最低觸及46,266點。資深證券分析師呂漢威指出，今日成交量預估在8000億元左右，低接買盤出現但未出現追買力道，在量能無法帶上來的情況下要在今日漲回來並不容易。

今日值班分析師： 資深證券分析師呂漢威

Fed如預期維持利率不變，美股方面，四大指數週三同步收紅，費半指數勁揚1.76%。不過台指期夜盤下跌128點，台股今日早盤也下挫逾600點。

呂漢威認為，昨日拉高之後，外資顯然還是有一些賣壓出現就今日的盤勢來看，有低接的買盤慢慢出現，但並沒有追買力道，因此要拉回平盤並不容易。

呂漢威也指出，現在這個時間點要漸漸地等待財報、營收出爐來刺激買盤，如今天的台光電等個股都有反映，但追價力道低導致漲勢無法擴張。

至於今日預估成交量，呂漢威認為，資金追買的意願並不高，量能相較昨日沒有擴張，帶約仍落在8000億元左右，還是呈現比較觀望的態勢，操作上還是建議逢低介入不追高避免風險。

news.Title: 富邦金拓美股延伸交易，雪梨分行搶攻企業金融
news.Content:

富邦金（2881）第4季先由富邦證券開放美股盤前與盤後交易，補上一般交易時段外的下單需求，客戶可在美國上市公司財報、法說會與重要經濟數據公布前後直接委託。盤前交易時段為台灣時間16時至21時30分或17時至22時30分，盤後為4時至6時或5時至7時，現階段僅接受當日限價委託。

銀行版圖則往澳洲推進，台北富邦銀行已設立雪梨分行，成為富邦集團首個南半球據點，承作聯貸、雙邊融資、貿易融資與跨境金融服務，鎖定台商與跨國企業在紐澳及亞洲之間的資金調度需求。後續授信方向已涵蓋能源轉型、基礎建設、高科技及醫療生技，企業金融與機構金融成為當地業務主軸。

財務面上，富邦金2026年前9月稅後淨利1,272.2億元，EPS為8.8元，雙創歷史同期次高，其中富邦人壽前9月FVOCI股票處分利得累計1,227.4億元，對保留盈餘影響數達2,499.6億元。台北富邦銀行截至2026年8月底外幣存款餘額為1兆3,017億元，在國銀排名第4，富邦人壽截至2025年度綠色金融投資規模達1.99兆元，2030年目標較基準年成長32%。

news.Title: 台股站回季線！ 杜金龍持股拉高至7成 「這3檔」緊抱到過年
news.Content:
台股多頭強勢反攻！台股加權指數28日大漲939.35點，收在47,035.58點，重新站回4萬7千點大關及季線，為近期震盪行情注入強心針。資深分析師杜金龍認為，台股在4萬6000點附近已展現支撐力道，隨著融資餘額快速下降、籌碼逐步沉澱，年底至明年初的跨年行情值得期待。他透露，已將個人持股比重從6成提高至7成以上，並點名台積電（2330）、欣興（3037）、南亞（1303）3檔個股，認為後續表現值得關注。

杜金龍持股加碼至7成

台股近期經歷一波修正，市場一度擔憂外資賣壓與籌碼鬆動，不過杜金龍觀察，大盤在45,676點附近出現支撐，指數跌破4萬6000點後也迅速反彈，加上短線融資餘額下降，有助於籌碼沉澱。他因此將持股比重從原本的6成提高至7成以上，對後續行情抱持期待。

至於進場節奏，杜金龍提出3個觀察時點，包括大盤大幅拉回時逢低布局、美國選舉前後，以及台灣選舉前後。他預估，11月下旬起台股有機會迎來跨年反彈行情，動能可能延續至2027年2月初，甚至5月。依據波浪理論推估，指數波段高點可望挑戰5萬3000點至6萬點，但實際走勢仍須觀察國際局勢、資金流向及市場基本面變化。

台積電、欣興、南亞成焦點

個股方面，杜金龍首先看好權值股台積電。他透露，先前在2420元及2390元分批買進，並觀察2380元附近的支撐力道。台積電28日上漲25元，收在2425元，後續表現仍須留意先進製程需求、AI晶片成長動能及外資買賣超。至於外資喊出的5000元長線目標價，仍屬市場預估，並非股價保證。

第二檔是ABF載板廠欣興。杜金龍透露以1090元買進，關注法說會釋出的營運展望，以及AI相關需求對載板產業的帶動。市場法人目標價則有1500元至1800元的評估，後續仍需觀察產業景氣、訂單及獲利表現。

第三檔為南亞。文章指出，南亞近期成交量放大，市場關注其轉投資南電、南亞科的表現，以及相關投資價值對公司淨值的影響。部分外資與本土法人將目標價調升至400元以上，惟股價能否進一步走高，仍取決於塑化景氣、轉投資績效與整體市場氣氛。

跨年行情能否延續？

台股28日大漲近千點，重新站回4萬7000點，短線氣氛明顯回溫。杜金龍看好4萬6000點附近的支撐，並提高個人持股比重，反映其對跨年行情的樂觀看法。不過，指數能否持續上攻、個股目標價是否實現，仍有不確定性。投資人布局台積電、欣興及南亞等標的時，仍應評估自身風險承受能力，留意股價波動、產業基本面與資金變化，避免單憑市場預測追高。

（封面圖／翻攝《賺錢放大術》YT頻道）
